title: Smart City Challenge: Austin Hosts DOT Secretary
summary:
*   Austin hosted a press conference with U.S. Department of Transportation Secretary Anthony Foxx and Mayor Steve Adler.
*   The discussion centered on the US DOT Smart City Challenge, highlighting federal initiatives.
*   This was a media availability event for discussion and information sharing.
*   No formal policy decisions or actions were taken by the City Council at this meeting.
